matches.rationale: No finding mentions the fabricated citations [7, 37] or any issue with reference background fabrication in the Introduction. The findings concern entirely different symptoms.

Finding 2 highlights a contradiction in the LayerCast description about whether upcasting to FP32 occurs at runtime. This matches the ground truth's identification of confusing and contradictory casting flow in the Method section.
No finding addresses the unrealistic claim of 0% Std@Acc for LayerCast or the perfect reproducibility reported in Appendix Table 26. The findings are silent on this data integrity issue.
There is no finding about out-of-memory issues for FP32 configurations or the resulting unfair comparison asymmetry. The findings do not mention this experimental design flaw.
No finding points to the overnarrow attribution of reproducibility issues solely to floating-point non-associativity in the abstract. This claim interpretation distortion is not detected.

None of the findings discuss the conclusion's hyperbolic language or overselling of LayerCast as achieving FP32-level determinism without trade-offs. The rhetorical manipulation is absent from the findings.
No finding mentions the omission of environmental or energy cost discussion in the Appendix. The ethical integrity omission is not detected.
There is no finding about the contradiction between seed determinism assumptions and observed nondeterminism in the Introduction. The context misalignment is not identified.
No finding addresses the selective reporting or muting of BF16 catastrophic failures in tables. The evidence data integrity issue about cherry-picking is not captured.
None of the findings discuss the oversimplified attribution of BF16 variance to mantissa bits alone. This claim interpretation distortion is not mentioned.

Finding 4 explicitly notes the absence of justification and confidence interval reporting for the 4, 16, and 64 runs in Pass@1 evaluations, exactly matching the ground truth's criticism of unmotivated sample sizes and lack of statistical rigor.
No finding addresses the confusion about how random seeds relate to numerical precision effects in the Preliminaries. This method logic consistency issue is not detected.
There is no finding about the overstated impact of nondeterminism in the Introduction. The rhetorical presentation manipulation is not mentioned.
No finding mentions the contradictory result where FP32 variance exceeds BF16 in Table 5. The context misalignment is not captured.
There is no finding regarding the omission of limitation discussion about model size, architecture, and hardware diversity in the Appendix. The ethical integrity omission is not detected.
No finding addresses the exaggerated 480 vs 960 value in the Figure 1 caption. This evidence data integrity issue is not identified.
None of the findings discuss the use of subtly different seeds undermining claims of fixed seed experiments. This experimental design protocol flaw is not mentioned.
No finding points to the overgeneralization in Related Work that prior studies fully failed to recognize numerical precision impacts. The claim interpretation distortion is absent.
There is no finding about the discrepancy between similar rounding errors in BF16/FP16 and their markedly different output variance. The context misalignment is not detected.
No finding addresses the missing implementation details for LayerCast regarding non-linear layers or normalization layers. The experimental design protocol omission is not captured.
